set.affordability_requirement: County PLHA plan funds Activity 1 (rental development for extremely low to moderate income households with 55-year covenants through the AHF process) and Activity 6 (homeless services, shelter and navigation center operations and case management). HCD 2024-2028 Formula Guidelines consolidate eligible uses into Rental, Affordable Owner-Occupied Workforce Housing (up to 120% AMI, 150% in high-cost areas) and Homelessness Assistance activities; rental projects need 55-year regulatory agreements and plans must prioritize households at or below 60% AMI. Neither the 2024-2028 guidelines nor the NOFA sets a mandatory owner-occupied share.
set.audit_note: Tier 4: removed unsupported claim that a 2024 HCD rule requires 40% of new PLHA funds for owner-occupied workforce housing; not found in the 2024-2028 PLHA Formula Guidelines or NOFA. Award figures, CY 2024 and 2025 estimates and the Aug 25, 2026 swap confirmed. prevailing_wage_trigger true rests only on the general state-funds rule; PLHA guidelines and NOFA do not state a prevailing wage requirement, so no prevailing_wage_basis is cited.

reason: Material: affordability_requirement stated a 40% owner-occupied set-aside for new funds that the 2024-2028 PLHA guidelines and NOFA do not contain.

set.audit_note: Tier 4: developer page matches on 5-unit threshold, rental 10% lower plus 5% very low income, ownership 7.5% moderate plus 7.5% lower income, and replacement housing rules. Page labels the income limits 2026. prevailing_wage_trigger false is uncited; a private inclusionary requirement involves no public funds, but no rule is named.

reason: Page matches on threshold, set-aside percentages, income tiers and replacement rules.
